description: Find the file an agent mentions and keep the workspace tree beside the conversation. Search by name or path, open previews, add relative paths to drafts, create a blank markdown file, delete a file after confirmation, and reveal or copy files from the machine that owns them. Files show Seti-style type icons for markdown, JSON, gitignore, env, and other common names. Project threads stay rooted in their checkout; personal threads can browse a configured folder. Requires local file access on the BB machine; Finder reveal is macOS-only.
